exposure: hormone replacement therapy (HRT) FET endometrial preparation
outcome: preterm premature rupture of the membrane (pPROM)
finding: Patients conceiving after OS FET had a lower risk of placenta previa and HDP compared to those after HRT FET.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were lower in the OS FET group compared to the HRT FET group.
birth_weight: Average birth weight was lower in the OS group compared to the HRT group (2982.3 ± 636.4 vs. 3025.0 ± 659.0, P < 0.001)
